description:

You see a closed fridge. You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto an oven. I mean, just wow! Isn't TextWorld just the best? You see a table. The table is massive. Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it.
inventory: You are carrying: an orange bell pepper and a yellow bell pepper.
